what_it_does: Bridges communication between Field-Programmable Gate Arrays (FPGAs, reconfigurable chips) and Graphics Processing Units (GPUs) over PCIe (a high-speed computer bus). The work uses AVX-512 vector instructions to move data directly from CPU registers at very low latency without going through slower kernel modes. GPU memory can be shared peer-to-peer across PCIe, allowing both accelerators to read and write each other's memory directly, eliminating copying overhead in heterogeneous computing systems.
